# koyeb_service_pool (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "koyeb_service_pool" "my-pool" {
  name = "my-pool"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The service pool name

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The date and time of when the service pool was created
- `customer_id` (String) The customer ID owning the service pool
- `definition` (List of Object) The deployment definition of the services provisioned by the pool (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--definition))
- `generation` (String) The current generation of the service pool
- `id` (String) The service pool ID
- `messages` (String) The service pool status messages
- `organization_id` (String) The organization ID owning the service pool
- `ready_count` (Number) The number of services currently ready in the pool
- `size` (Number) The number of prewarmed services kept ready in the pool
- `status` (String) The service pool status
- `updated_at` (String) The date and time of when the service pool was last updated
- `workspace_id` (String) The workspace ID owning the service pool
